title: Ensilage Microflora for Xanthophyll & Carotene Extraction and Catfish Pigmentation
institution: Department of Microbiology, SIES College of Arts, Science & Commerce (Empowered Autonomous), Sion, Mumbai
summary: Transforms municipal and temple marigold (Tagetes erecta) floral waste into high-value xanthophylls (lutein) and carotenes using anaerobic microbial ensilage. Evaluates biological uptake and coloration in freshwater catfish tissues to replace synthetic feed additives.

scientificPillars.title: Biomass Stabilization & Ensilage
scientificPillars.description: Floral offerings rot rapidly when discarded in water bodies, releasing methane and depleting dissolved oxygen. Anaerobic fermentation drops pH through lactic acid production, preserving delicate carotenoids from oxidation.

scientificPillars.title: In-situ Cellulolytic Lysis
scientificPillars.description: Endogenous microflora and selected microbial strains produce cellulases and pectinases that digest thick plant cell walls, yielding up to 24.9 g of lutein per kg of flower dry matter without toxic halogenated organic solvents.

scientificPillars.title: GC-MS Compound Fingerprinting
scientificPillars.description: Gas chromatography and mass spectrometry profiling identifies bioactive phytobiotics, fatty acid methyl esters, and antioxidant terpenes generated during ensilage fermentation.

scientificPillars.title: Aquaculture Nutrition Efficacy
scientificPillars.description: Incorporation of microbially-extracted pigments into trial diets for catfish (Clarias batrachus / Pangasianodon hypophthalmus) with quantitative assessment of skin pigmentation and serum antioxidant markers.

microorganisms.name: Lactobacillus plantarum
microorganisms.role: Rapid acidification, pH reduction (<4.2), and carotenoid preservation against oxidation

microorganisms.name: Flavobacterium IIb
microorganisms.role: Synergistic pigment stabilization and organic acid production

microorganisms.name: Acinetobacter anitratus
microorganisms.role: Biochemical bioconversion in ensilage flora succession

microorganisms.name: Rhizopus nigricans
microorganisms.role: Potent cellulase and pectinase synthesis for lignocellulosic wall lysis

outcomes: Published peer-reviewed paper in JETIR (Vol 9, Issue 8, 2022).
Presented at University of Mumbai Aavishkar Research Convention.
Established non-destructive green extraction protocol for lutein recovery.
Zero-effluent floral waste valorization model applicable to temples across Maharashtra.

title: Experiential Pedagogy Framework: Mind Maps & Pre-Lab Worksheets in Microbiology
institution: SIES College of Arts, Science & Commerce, Sion
summary: A research-backed pedagogical model addressing cognitive overload in undergraduate science laboratories by combining visual mind mapping, pre-laboratory structured worksheets, and formative digital quizzes.

scientificPillars.title: Visual Cognitive Chunking
scientificPillars.description: Mind maps link abstract biological principles (e.g. electron transport or bacterial operons) directly to the bench-level steps students perform in the laboratory.

scientificPillars.title: Pre-Lab Formative Inquiry
scientificPillars.description: Students complete guided pre-lab worksheets before stepping into the laboratory, shifting laboratory hours from passive reading to active hypothesis testing.

scientificPillars.title: Retention Measurement
scientificPillars.description: Pre-test and post-test assessments showed a statistically significant increase in 60-day concept retention and a 38% decrease in procedural bench errors.

outcomes: Integrated into B.Sc. Semester II practical handbook published by My Rays Publishing House.
Shared openly on ResearchGate for STEM educators across universities.
Adopted across multiple laboratory modules in the Microbiology Department at SIES College.
